## Problem and result

Describe the player-visible problem and the final behavior. Link the issue when applicable.

## Validation

List relevant checks, manual flows and known limits. Include screenshots for meaningful UI changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and keeps the main panel simple.
- [ ] UI text and documentation are in English.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; changed behavior has appropriate coverage.
- [ ] Model/data changes include provenance and preserve unknown values.
- [ ] No profiles, captures, secrets or unrelated generated files are included.
